name: Billie Beetleneck -A detective tale-
source:
An unusual number of booklice and humans have escaped their worlds to seek refuge in Bugtown due to a large number of attacks from bookworms.

Bookworms feed on knowledge by eating up pages of various books and destroying the worlds within in the process. Characters inside the books must flee, or perish during such devastating attacks. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399200/Billie_Beetleneck_A_detective_tale/]Steam[/url]]
